sys_script_include.description: Warehouse-aware demand forecasting engine. Calculates historical demand from customer orders, production requirements, inventory requests, and safety stock consumption — per Material + Warehouse. Generates weighted moving average forecasts with trend detection, projects stock levels, and creates replenishment recommendations. Detects repeated safety stock consumption as a signal for review (never auto-modifies safety stock).
sys_script_include.name: DemandForecastEngine
